definitions.full: H2631. chasan [ חֲסֵן ] verb Haph`el take . . . possession of (Syriac be strong, overcome ; ᵑ7 be strong, take possession of ; Egyptian Aramaic Haph`el חחסן hold property S-C D 2 +, compare Biblical Hebrew חסן ); — Perfect 3masculine plural הֶחֱסִ֫נ (K § 38. 3 Kmp on the passage ) Dan 7:22 ; Imperfect 3masculine plural יַחְסְנוּן (K § 38. 1 b )) 7:18 (perhaps point סִנוּן -).
